title: lint-tree
summary: Answers one question lint-all cannot: does an interface edit to this unit reach any dependent?
intro: Read this before you save or commit an edit to a unit that other units use. It checks whether an interface change reaches any dependent, which lint-all cannot show because a removed symbol simply stops being linted.

help: ^ does an interface edit to <B.pas> reach any dependent? Exits 0 whether or
not it found anything; 2 means it could NOT run. --baseline pins the OLD
side to an edit-episode capture -- without it the OLD side is the live
index, which is CLI/manual use only.

pitfalls: does an interface edit to `<B.pas>` reach any dependent? Exits 0 whether or not it found anything; 2 means it could NOT run. --baseline pins the OLD side to an edit-episode capture -- without it the OLD side is the live index, which is CLI/manual use only.
